instruction.name: xvmaddwod.d.wu
instruction.description: Multiply the odd-positioned unsigned 32-bit elements in `b` and the corresponding unsigned 32-bit elements in `c`, extending both to 64-bit, and add the product to the 64-bit elements in `a`.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4' --asm 'xvmaddwod.d.wu $xr0, $xr1, $xr2'
